project.name: skillforge
project.summary: A hosted web app that helps non-technical skill creators turn ideas into valid skill packages.

vision: Make skill creation accessible to non-technical creators by turning an idea into a valid, usable skill package through a hosted web app.
coreJourney: Open the hosted SkillForge web app.
Describe the intended skill without needing skill-authoring expertise.
Receive a generated skill package that conforms to the selected validity standard.

goals.statement: Enable non-technical skill creators to turn an idea into a valid skill package through a hosted web app.

requirements.statement: Provide the first release as a hosted web application.
Accept a creator's skill idea and generate a package that can be checked against the selected skill standard.

productPrinciples: Use language and guidance that do not require prior skill-authoring expertise.

officialFacts.statement: The first-release problem is turning ideas into valid skill packages.
The primary first-release user is a non-technical skill creator.
The first release is a hosted web app.
